Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualClientSocket, VirtualClient
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements VirtualClientSocket
Handles server-side communication for a single connected socket client. Implements VirtualClientSocket to deserialize incoming requests and forward them to the server, while serializing server events and errors to be sent back to the client.

    • SocketClientHandler

      public SocketClientHandler(SocketClientHandlersManager server, BufferedReader input, PrintWriter output, Socket socket)
      Constructs a new SocketClientHandler.
      Parameters:
      server - the SocketClientHandlersManager responsible for processing the incoming requests.
      input - the BufferedReader for reading serialized requests from the client.
      output - the PrintWriter for sending serialized events back to the client.
      socket - the primary Socket connection defining the client session.

  • Method Details

    • runVirtualView

      public void runVirtualView() throws IOException
      Starts the main listener loop that reads incoming data from the primary socket, parses the JSON messages into ClientRequest objects, and forwards them to the server manager.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading or if the socket is closed.

    • setPingSocket

      public void setPingSocket(BufferedReader pingInput, PrintWriter pingOutput, Socket pingSocket, String nickname)
      Sets up the secondary socket connection specifically used for network heartbeats (pings).
      Parameters:
      pingInput - the BufferedReader for reading ping messages from the client.
      pingOutput - the PrintWriter for sending ping responses back.
      pingSocket - the secondary Socket used for keep-alive validation.
      nickname - the nickname of the currently connected user.

    • runPingServer

      public void runPingServer() throws IOException
      Starts the listener loop for the secondary ping socket. Continuously reads incoming ping requests and notifies the server manager to update the client's last seen timestamp.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while listening for pings or if the socket drops.
